newsitem.title: USA: SALLIE MAE NAMES NEW CFO.
newsitem.headline: SALLIE MAE NAMES NEW CFO.

text.p: SLM Holding Corp, the holding company of the Student Loan Marketing Association, said Wednesday it has named a new chief financial officer.
Mark Overend has been named the new chief financial officer, succeeding Denise McGlone, who is resigning.
The exact reason for McGlone's departure, which comes several weeks after shareholders voted to privatize the government-sponsored enterprise, was not immediately available.
Most recently, Overend was vice president and controller at Sallie Mae.

Sallie Mae said it also has named Marianne Keler as vice president and general counsel; Robert Levine as vice president of servicing; Tracie MacMahon, vice president of systems; and Jane Trevisan as vice president of marketing and sales.
